messages.subject: updateNumericInput - wrong number
parts:
updateNumericInput(session,"profID",value = 102145) results in 102140 instead of 102145 being printed in the NumericInput field. Weird. 
Am working with windows7, 64bit arch, using 64bit R v3.0.2 and shiny v0.8.0.
